extension.description: Scrobbles your Kodi playback to your self-hosted Chronicle server, and syncs ratings, artwork, and watch counts both ways. Chronicle is the source of truth for ratings and art (always pushed to Kodi); play counts and last-played dates reconcile in whichever direction has the more recent watch. Covers movies, movie collections, TV shows, and individual episodes. Supports resetting Kodi watch progress for a fresh rewatch while keeping your full history safe in Chronicle.
extension.news: v2.0.7 - Rebuilt Settings to match SIMKL Scrobbler's layout: Connection tab now leads with the Chronicle URL field followed directly by a "Connect to Chronicle" QR/PIN button and a read-only status line, so connecting never requires typing an API key by hand. settings.xml also switched to the classic flat schema (proven against SIMKL's own real, working settings.xml) instead of the newer section/group schema, since that's what supports an in-page action button. Unconfigured clicks go straight to this Settings page again, matching SIMKL's own first-run behavior. v2.0.6 - Fix: opening the addon once a URL was set but before connecting reopened Settings instead of the menu, making "Connect to Chronicle" unreachable without typing an API key by hand. The first-run check no longer also requires the key. Also flattened description/changelog text -- the XML source's line-wrapping indentation was being rendered literally in Kodi's add-on info screen. v2.0.5 - Fix: Chronicle URL field was silently missing from the Connection settings page (allowempty=false combined with an empty default made Kodi drop just that one setting). v2.0.4 - Fix: "This add-on can't be configured" when opening Settings (settings.xml used an unsupported schema variant). v2.0.3 - Fix: addon showed Kodi's generic fallback icon instead of the Chronicle "C" (icon.png wasn't declared via an <assets> block). v2.0.2 - Fix: opening the addon before it's configured now jumps straight to Settings instead of a menu that would only fail. v2.0.1 - Fix: removed the xbmc.gui dependency declaration, which isn't a real resolvable addon and broke every install. v2.0.0 - Bidirectional sync: ratings + art (Chronicle -> Kodi, source of truth) and play count / last-played reconciliation for movies, movie collections, TV shows, and episodes. v1.1.0 - QR code device authentication; sync Chronicle lists to Kodi playlists v1.0.0 - Initial release
